# 1. Product Introduction

*Page 1 (PDF page 2, left)*

FlashBot is an intelligent delivery robot for hotels and offices. <!-- internal note -->

It carries meals, linens and small parcels between floors.

## 1.1 Specifications

*Page 2 (PDF page 3, right)*

| Parameter | Value |
|---|---|
| Payload | 30 kg |
| Battery capacity | 15 Ah |
| Max speed | 1.2 m/s |

# 2. Operation

*Page 5 (PDF page 6, left)*

## 2.1 Starting the robot

Press the power button for three seconds. The indicator turns solid green when the robot is ready.

> **Warning:** do not block the Lidar while the robot is moving.
